scientific_state: R2-10/R2-11/R2-12 remain valid; R3 showed the original runtime event stream was not semantically equivalent to R2; R3-03A corrected it (one policy access per (pass,layer)); real-model conformance passes.
research_question: After semantic correction, what is the direct critical-path cost of retention-policy bookkeeping, and does that cost explain the end-to-end predicted_protect_sham vs b_selected difference?
out_of_scope: any generalisation beyond the A-4GiB semantic routing stream for microbenchmark values
use of the old +/-1% baseline precision criterion
use of the Linux VM exploratory values for any decision beyond feasibility

policies.predicted_protect_sham: b_selected parameters + predictor decay .99, top_k 8, n_experts 128, sham=true
policies.predicted_protect: same predictor parameters, sham=false (microbenchmark only; no end-to-end throughput inference)

estimands.c_call: ns per semantic policy access, per policy: mean over repetitions of (bulk_total_ns - null_total_ns)/events
estimands.fraction_of_step: c_token / decode step wall time (step wall time only available from end-to-end runs; not defined for the microbenchmark)
estimands.O: end-to-end per-token wall difference sham - b_selected, per ABBA block
estimands.P: in-situ instrumented bookkeeping difference per token (ns_policy_total/token, sham - b_selected), per ABBA block, from the same launches
estimands.rho: mean_b(O_b) / mean_b(P_b); confidence interval by Fieller's method on block-paired means (t quantile, df = blocks-1); unbounded Fieller set => untestable

primary_decision_criterion: Mechanism EXPLAINED iff the two-sided 95% Fieller confidence interval for rho lies entirely inside the equivalence interval [0.5, 2.0].

justification: rho=O/P is dimensionless; a ratio is symmetric on the log scale, so +/-ln2 is the natural symmetric tolerance.

rho<0.5 would leave more than half of the observed overhead unexplained by the instrumented bookkeeping; rho>2 would mean the timers count more than twice the observed cost, contradicting a critical-path model (overlap, mis-measurement).

rho=1 is not required exactly: unmeasured secondary effects (cache pollution, lock interaction, part of the work off the critical path, timer overhead ~1 us/call on the VM exploratory run) can legitimately move rho within a factor of two.
No empirical basis exists for a tighter interval; the old +/-1% baseline-precision criterion belongs to a different estimand and is NOT reused.
Passing therefore supports only: 'instrumented bookkeeping accounts for between half and double of the observed overhead'; it does not support 'fully explains'.
equivalence_interval.precision_gate: Before acquisition (after the host microbenchmark) the required ABBA block count is N_req = ceil((t_{N-1,0.975} * sigma_c / (0.5 * P_hat))^2), with P_hat from the authoritative host microbenchmark (c_predictor_token as fraction of the measured step time) and sigma_c the ABBA-contrast SD derived from the R3-02-p4 between-launch CV (8 GiB A 3.8%, B 1.7%; contrast SD = sqrt((CVA^2+CVB^2)/2)). If N_req exceeds the block cap, the end-to-end test is declared a-priori UNDERPOWERED for the 'explained' verdict and only the 'inconclusive' / 'rejected' branches are attainable; this is decided and recorded in a separate pre-acquisition addendum, never after seeing end-to-end data.

decision_branches.REJECTED_UNEXPLAINED: Fieller 95% CI for rho entirely below 0.5 or entirely above 2.0
decision_branches.INCONCLUSIVE: CI bounded but straddles an interval bound
decision_branches.UNTESTABLE: P not distinguishable from 0 (Fieller set unbounded) or O/P below timer or launch-noise resolution

authoritative_microbenchmark.platform: Windows host (same machine as the runtime builds)
authoritative_microbenchmark.toolchain: MSVC cl 19.44.x from VS 2022 BuildTools (runtime build family 19.44.35229.0); run aborts if cl major.minor is not 19.44
authoritative_microbenchmark.policy_implementation: patches/argine-retention-policy.cpp exactly as in the instrumented runtime source (same file, no copy)

input.config: budget 4294967296 bytes, decay .99, interval 64, predictor decay .99, top_k 8, n_experts 128

authoritative_microbenchmark.repetition_rule: exactly 30 per process, exactly 3 processes; no optional stopping; an interrupted or failed process invalidates the whole run directory, which is kept and a new fresh directory is used for a full rerun
authoritative_microbenchmark.interleaving: within each repetition the 3 policies run in rotating order (rep mod 3, reversed on odd reps); the 4 timing modes (null, bulk, outer, inner) run for each policy; mode order alternates by repetition

modes.null: copy of the expert vector per event only, one timer pair around the whole replay (baseline)
modes.bulk: one timer pair around the whole replay, policy timing OFF (PRIMARY for c_call; immune to timer quantization)
modes.outer: timer pair around every access(), policy timing OFF (per-call distribution, per-token-equivalent sums)
modes.inner: as outer with internal PolicyTiming ON (prediction-update and victim-selection shares, instrumentation overhead)

authoritative_microbenchmark.warmup_rule: 2 unrecorded complete replays for every (policy, mode) combination at process start (in fixed order), discarded from all statistics but logged; no further warmup
authoritative_microbenchmark.timer: std::chrono::steady_clock; calibration of 1,000,000 back-to-back read pairs and 1,000,000 minimum-nonzero-tick probes at process start; raw pair deltas retained
validity_checks: every replay of b_selected and predicted_protect_sham must produce exactly 41786 evictions and identical hits/misses (else run invalid)
every replay of a given policy must reproduce identical hits/misses/evictions across repetitions and modes (else run invalid)
predicted_protect eviction count is recorded without a reference (informational)
no per-call duration may exceed 2^32-1 ns (else run invalid)
authoritative_microbenchmark.raw_data: all per-call outer and inner durations (uint32 ns) retained in binary files; all per-replay totals retained in JSON lines; calibration raw deltas retained
authoritative_microbenchmark.statistics: mean, median, SD, p90, p99, p99.9, max of per-call outer durations; per-repetition means with between-repetition SD; per-process and pooled; no outlier removal or trimming

estimators.c_call: mean over all repetitions of (bulk_total - null_total)/events (same-repetition null)
estimators.c_predictor: paired difference over repetitions, 95% t interval, df=89; process-wise values also reported
estimators.timer_overhead: outer-mode mean per call minus bulk-derived c_call per policy; calibration pair median; instrumentation overhead = inner minus outer mean
estimators.shares: prediction_update_share and victim_selection_share = inner decomposition / inner ns_policy_total

authoritative_microbenchmark.binary_identity: SHA-256 of the built executable and SHA-256 of both source files recorded in the run directory; compiler version and flags recorded
authoritative_microbenchmark.output_dir_rule: fresh additive directory C:\Users\alpel\Desktop\Argine4-r3runs\R3-03B-microbench-run1; the command refuses to run if it already exists
